seo_description: Full audio post-production for a 90-second horror teaser. Creature vocals from layered animal recordings, binaural 3D mix, 4 weeks solo.
hero.title: Amorak
hero.subtitle: Sound Design / Horror Animation / Binaural 3D Mix
about.text: 90-second horror teaser. A man hears something outside, hides in the basement, and traps the creature. I built the creature voice from layered animal recordings (lion, elephant, tiger, hippo), designed all environments to sound claustrophobic and wet, and mixed everything in binaural 3D so it works on headphones. 4 weeks, solo.
sound.s1.title: Creature Voice
sound.s1.desc: 4 layered animal recordings pitched down. Lion for weight, hippo for the raspy high end.
sound.s2.title: Basement Ambience
sound.s2.desc: Dripping water, creaking wood, chains, rats. Every sound placed in 3D space with Dear VR Pro.
sound.s3.title: Binaural Mix
sound.s3.desc: Creature always wins in the mix. Dynamic ducking keeps breathing audible through the chaos.
